title: rbac-v2: enforce KMS region pinning + augment audit logging for cross-region access
author: Priya Rao
description: Motivation: Customers in regulated environments require strict data residency guarantees for key material and cryptographic operations. RBAC v2 policies previously allowed KMS key ARNs to be set on projects and services but did not consistently enforce region pinning when policies were created or mutated. This PR enforces region pinning at the RBAC v2 policy validator layer, augments audit logs to capture cross-region KMS access attempts, and adds migration tooling and docs. Changes include: 1) server-side RBAC v2 validator: new validation rule that rejects policies referencing KMS keys outside the project's allowed regions; 2) KMS integration layer: policy-aware key resolution that prevents accidental fallback to global keys; 3) audit-logger: structured events for KMS key region mismatches and access attempts; 4) private-installer hooks: pre-check to surface region/key mismatches during upgrades; 5) migration CLI: dry-run and apply modes for scanning existing policies and optionally pinning allowed regions or flagging exceptions; 6) tests: unit coverage for validator + integration test that simulates cross-region KMS access and asserts audit entries. Migration notes: run `bin/rw-kms-migrate --dry-run` in staging to list impacted policies; changes are opt-in for customers still on RBAC v1; for RBAC v2 users the server will start rejecting new/updated policies that violate region constraints once feature flag `rbac.v2.kms_region_enforce` is enabled. Related: Linear ENG-11428, Security ticket SEC-3221.
